title: Athlete Profile System
description: A four-image reference-dependent family that locks one athlete-card language across portrait, stat, action, and captaincy surfaces.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the original athlete, portrait lighting, stat-zone geometry, and team-neutral card grammar. Images 02-04 depend on that anchor and push the same profile system into different editorial and social use cases.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-stat-dominant-card, 03-action-burst-card, 04-captain-editorial-card. Queue may run 02-stat-dominant-card, 03-action-burst-card, 04-captain-editorial-card concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
